metadata.title: Stylized 3D Character Group with Blackletter Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A trio of stylized 3D characters in urban attire set against a flat teal background with bold, geometric blackletter typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: Three stylized 3D male characters with distinct urban fashion (beanies, glasses, sweaters) standing in a row. The central figure faces forward while the flanking figures are in profile or three-quarter view. The scene is characterized by soft studio lighting, a textured teal backdrop, and prominent, angular blackletter text framing the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure acts as the vertical axis for the composition
Typography frames the characters at the top and bottom
High-contrast color blocking between clothing and background
Consistent 3D rendering style across all characters
coreInvariants: Stylized 3D character proportions with simplified facial features

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three characters centered horizontally, occupying the middle 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central character in the yellow turtleneck and red beanie.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large bottom text, move up to the central character's face, then scan the flanking characters and top text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform teal space surrounding the character group and between the text blocks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and clothing; medium value range with soft shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Broken-script aesthetic with modern, sharp edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'N' use sharp, triangular negative spaces
Terminals are consistently pointed and symmetrical
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform font style used for both primary and secondary text blocks to maintain brand consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, geometric take on traditional blackletter.
Captures the rigid, blocky construction of the letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D render of three stylized urban characters in a row against a textured teal wall. The central character wears a yellow turtleneck and red beanie; the left wears a red jacket and yellow beanie; the right wears a green vest and black beanie.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, geometric blackletter text in teal at the bottom, overlapping the characters' legs, and smaller matching text at the top.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid teal color?
Does the bottom text overlap the characters?

postGenerationChecks: Check for geometric consistency in letterforms
Ensure characters have a stylized, non-photorealistic look
Verify teal color matching between background and text
Confirm the central character is the focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Stylized 3D character trio + [Clothing Style] + [Background Color] + Geometric Blackletter Typography overlay.
